messages.subject: facet_wrap problem
parts:
Dear all,

I cannot figure out why this is giving a problem. Any idea?

Thanks!

Adi



library(reshape)
library(ggplot2)

myDf = expand.grid(x=seq(1,3), y=0, group=factor(c('A','B','C')), mean=0)
myDf$y = c(rnorm(3, mean=1), rnorm(3, mean=2), rnorm(3, mean=3))
myDf$mean = c(rep(1,3), rep(2,3), rep(3,3))

ggplot(myDf) + geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y)) + facet_wrap(~ group, scales='free', nrow=1)

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: facet_wrap problem
parts:
Works for me in the development version but not in 0.8.9. It appears
you've been bitten by the 'group' buglet, because if you change
'group' to 'gp' it works in 0.8.9. This problem (variable names the
same as aesthetics) has been fixed in the upcoming version.

HTH,
Dennis
